newsitem.title: USA: Prudential reorganizes muni area, Spector leaves.
newsitem.headline: Prudential reorganizes muni area, Spector leaves.

text.p: Prudential Securities on Thursday said it had reunited its public finance banking area with municipal sales and trading, a move that triggered the departure of the head of public finance, Arthur Spector.

"We've been looking at how to make the firm more cost-efficient and effective for some time," said Charles Perkins, a spokesman for Prudential. "There were some redundancies. By combining the two areas under one person, it will bring more focus to the department."
He added that the as a result of the reorganization, Spector decided to leave. The former head of the banking area was not immediately available to comment.
Gerald McBride, who had been in charge of municipal sales and trading, also was put in charge of banking.
The Prudential spokesman declined comment on a published report that about five positions are being cut from the newly reorganized department, which employs about 171 people.
